errorReasons.permission_denied: Access was denied. Check folder or credential-store permissions.
errorReasons.file_busy: Another program is using the file. Try again shortly.
errorReasons.database_busy: The local database is busy. Try again shortly.
errorReasons.disk_full: The disk is full. Free some space and try again.
errorReasons.read_only: The storage location is read-only. Check write permissions.
errorReasons.not_found: The required file or record is missing. Reload and try again.
errorReasons.invalid_data: The data is invalid or damaged. Check its source.
errorReasons.timeout: The operation timed out. Check the connection and try again.
errorReasons.connection_lost: The connection was lost. Check your network and try again.
errorReasons.connection_refused: The server refused the connection. Check its address, port, and your network.
errorReasons.server_rejected: The server rejected the request. Check account authorization and server settings.
errorReasons.protocol: The server response could not be processed. Check server compatibility.
errorReasons.constraint: A data constraint conflicted. Reload and try again.
errorReasons.database: A local database operation failed. Use the error code and logs to investigate.
errorReasons.io: An I/O operation failed. Check available space, permissions, and connectivity.
errorReasons.network: The network request failed. Check connectivity and try again.
errorReasons.credential_missing: Saved credentials were not found. Authenticate again.
errorReasons.credential_store: The credential store is unavailable. Check your system login and credential service.
errorReasons.task_panicked: A background task stopped unexpectedly. Restart the app and keep the logs.
errorReasons.task_cancelled: The background task was cancelled. Try the operation again.
errorReasons.unknown: The underlying cause is not yet classified. Use the error code and logs to investigate.
